verdict.rationale: Creating soundbites or highlight clips is a fair capability to ask of a meeting-notes and call-capture tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents sharing whole notes via a link or team folders, CSV export of transcripts, and tracing notes back to their transcript source. Nothing shows cutting or sharing an audio or video clip of a specific moment.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can cut a soundbite or highlight clip from a call and share that moment instead of the whole recording
